name: SZZT Electronics CO.,LTD
summary: SZZT Electronics CO.,LTD provides financial electronic equipment products primarily in China and internationally. The company offers POS machines, cloud speakers, card making machines, facial recognition payment terminals, cash registers, mobile payment scanning terminals, desktop smart terminals, agricultural service terminals, encryption keyboards, payment kits, tax control service terminals, and other equipment.
